about: Dấu labels “Đề xuất” for underlining (D13) only on an app where in-place replacement measured wrong and underline right: Ghostty, Terminal. Every app types without underline until the user turns it on. Apps where a terminal is one field among many (VS Code, Cursor, Claude) are not labeled for their terminal (D43). Bundle IDs from docs/Compatibility.md section 3. The website (site/) reads measured, inPlaceCorrect and measuredMacOS for its app count and its list of apps verified to type correctly; webApps are measured web pages, which have no bundle ID. The app ignores these keys.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.note: Electron. Measured 10/11/2026 (VS Code 1.145.2, M1 machine): in-place right in 14 of 15 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal; the other run lost its first few keys right after an Apple Telex field chosen through the API. 17/11/2026 (VS Code 1.146.0, M1 machine): right in 2 of 2 runs at 5 ms, each right after an Apple Telex field chosen by the system shortcut; no key lost.

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.note: Chromium. Measured 10/11/2026 (M3 Max machine): in-place right in 7 of 7 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal and 3 of 3 with a busy page; 3 of 3 with a busy page again on 17/11/2026 (Chrome 157, M1 machine, edited string at 100 ± 30 ms); TipTap editor 9 of 9 (12/11/2026); label removed.

apps.name: Microsoft Edge
apps.note: Chromium (Microsoft Edge Framework). Measured 10/11/2026 (M1 machine): in-place right in 9 of 9 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal and 3 of 3 with a busy page; 17/11/2026 (Edge 157.0.4341.60, M1 machine): 2 of 2 at 5 ms and 1 of 1 with a busy page (edited string at 100 ± 30 ms); label removed.

apps.name: Brave
apps.note: Chromium (inferred). Not measured.

apps.name: Arc
apps.note: Chromium (inferred). Not measured.

apps.name: Cursor
apps.note: Electron. One app with two kinds of window: Agents (a prompt box) and IDE (the editor and an agent panel, ⌘L). Measured 23/11/2026 (3.31.15, docs/Compatibility.md 5.4): agent panel and Agents box in-place right at 5 ms; the editor right when it reports positions from the start of the document, and when its field holds only the word before the cursor the edit string is right 9 of 10 at 5 ms and 3 of 3 at 10 ms. Underline not measured.

apps.name: Ghostty
apps.note: Terminal drawn by the app (AppKit, Metal). Ignores replacementRange and reports the cursor at {0,0}; Dấu has no special handling for it (D43). Measured 11–12/11/2026 (1.4.0, docs/Compatibility.md 5.6): in-place wrong at 120 ms; underline right, but Return right after an underlined word is swallowed (Ghostty's own bug, Apple's Telex too).

apps.name: Terminal
apps.note: Apple Terminal. Measured 17/11/2026 (2.15, docs/Compatibility.md 5.5): in-place right at 30 ms and above, wrong with keys under 30 ms apart (5 ms 0/2, 10 ms 1/2, 20 ms 1/2); underline right 3/3 at 5, 10 and 20 ms; Apple Telex also wrong under 30 ms. Terminal does not pass ⌫ to the input method (6.5).

Chrome and Safari. Measured (docs/Compatibility.md 5.10): in-place wrong, the page reports the cursor at (1, 0); Dấu underlines this field on its own (D13), so text is right after the first one or two words of each new tab (26/11/2026).
